"Implement the solution in src/main/java/MazeGenerator.java so that the tests in src/test/java/MazeGeneratorTest.java pass. The specification follows.

# Instructions

Your task is to generate the perfect mazes for Mickey and Minerva — those with only one solution and no isolated sections.
Here's what you need to know:

- The maze has a rectangular shape with an opening at the start and end.
- The maze has rooms and passages, which intersect at right angles.
- The program should accept two parameters: rows and columns. The maze should be between 5 and 100 cells in size.
- A maze which is `x` columns wide and `y` rows high should be `2x + 1` characters wide and `2y + 1` characters high.
- If no seed is provided, generate a random maze. If the same seed is provided multiple times, the resulting maze should be the same each time.
- Use [box-drawing][Box-drawing] characters to draw walls, and an arrow symbol (⇨) for the entrance on the left and exit on the right.

It's time to create some perfect mazes for these adventurous mice!

## Examples

1. A small square maze 5x5 cells (or 11x11 characters)

    ```text
    ┌───────┬─┐
    │       │ │
    │ ┌─┬── │ │
    │ │ │   │ ⇨
    │ │ │ ──┤ │
    ⇨ │ │   │ │
    ┌─┤ └── │ │
    │ │     │ │
    │ │ ────┘ │
    │         │
    └─────────┘
    ```

2. A rectangular maze 6x18 cells

    ```text
    ┌───────────┬─────────┬───────────┬─┐
    │           │         │           │ │
    │ ┌───────┐ │ ┌─┐ ──┐ └───┐ ┌───┐ │ │
    │ │       │ │ │ │   │     │ │   │   ⇨
    │ └─┐ ┌─┐ │ │ │ ├── ├───┐ │ │ ──┼── │
    │   │ │ │   │   │   │   │ │ │   │   │
    └── │ │ ├───┴───┤ ┌─┘ ┌─┘ │ ├── │ ──┤
    ⇨   │   │       │ │   │   │ │   │   │
    ┌─┬─┴─┐ └─┐ ┌─┐ │ └─┐ │ ┌─┘ │ ──┴─┐ │
    │ │   │   │ │ │ │   │   │   │     │ │
    │ │ │ └── │ │ │ └── │ ──┘ ┌─┘ ──┐ │ │
    │   │       │       │     │     │   │
    └───┴───────┴───────┴─────┴─────┴───┘
    ```

[Box-drawing]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box-drawing_character


Do NOT modify the tests or the build files except as stated below. Do not create new files unless the specification requires them; Helper classes may go only in the solution's package."

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

public class MazeGenerator {

    private static final int MIN_SIZE = 5;
    private static final int MAX_SIZE = 100;
    private static final char ENTRANCE_EXIT = '⇨';

    public char[][] generatePerfectMaze(int rows, int columns) {
        return generatePerfectMaze(rows, columns, new Random());
    }

    public char[][] generatePerfectMaze(int rows, int columns, int seed) {
        return generatePerfectMaze(rows, columns, new Random(seed));
    }

    private char[][] generatePerfectMaze(int rows, int columns, Random random) {
        validate(rows, columns);

        boolean[][] hWall = new boolean[rows - 1][columns];
        boolean[][] vWall = new boolean[rows][columns - 1];
        for (boolean[] row : hWall) Arrays.fill(row, true);
        for (boolean[] row : vWall) Arrays.fill(row, true);

        carveMaze(rows, columns, hWall, vWall, random);

        return renderMaze(rows, columns, hWall, vWall);
    }

    private void validate(int rows, int columns) {
        if (rows < MIN_SIZE || rows > MAX_SIZE || columns < MIN_SIZE || columns > MAX_SIZE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "rows and columns must be between " + MIN_SIZE + " and " + MAX_SIZE);
        }
    }

    private void carveMaze(int rows, int columns, boolean[][] hWall, boolean[][] vWall, Random random) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][columns];
        int[] stackI = new int[rows * columns];
        int[] stackJ = new int[rows * columns];
        int top = 0;

        int i = random.nextInt(rows);
        int j = random.nextInt(columns);
        visited[i][j] = true;
        stackI[top] = i;
        stackJ[top] = j;
        top++;

        while (top > 0) {
            i = stackI[top - 1];
            j = stackJ[top - 1];

            int neighborCount = 0;
            int[] ni = new int[4];
            int[] nj = new int[4];
            // 0: north, 1: south, 2: west, 3: east
            if (i > 0 && !visited[i - 1][j]) { ni[neighborCount] = i - 1; nj[neighborCount] = j; neighborCount++; }
            if (i < rows - 1 && !visited[i + 1][j]) { ni[neighborCount] = i + 1; nj[neighborCount] = j; neighborCount++; }
            if (j > 0 && !visited[i][j - 1]) { ni[neighborCount] = i; nj[neighborCount] = j - 1; neighborCount++; }
            if (j < columns - 1 && !visited[i][j + 1]) { ni[neighborCount] = i; nj[neighborCount] = j + 1; neighborCount++; }

            if (neighborCount == 0) {
                top--;
            } else {
                int choice = random.nextInt(neighborCount);
                int ni2 = ni[choice];
                int nj2 = nj[choice];
                removeWall(hWall, vWall, i, j, ni2, nj2);
                visited[ni2][nj2] = true;
                stackI[top] = ni2;
                stackJ[top] = nj2;
                top++;
            }
        }
    }

    private void removeWall(boolean[][] hWall, boolean[][] vWall, int i, int j, int ni, int nj) {
        if (ni == i - 1) {
            hWall[i - 1][j] = false;
        } else if (ni == i + 1) {
            hWall[i][j] = false;
        } else if (nj == j - 1) {
            vWall[i][j - 1] = false;
        } else {
            vWall[i][j] = false;
        }
    }

    private char[][] renderMaze(int rows, int columns, boolean[][] hWall, boolean[][] vWall) {
        int H = 2 * rows + 1;
        int W = 2 * columns + 1;
        char[][] maze = new char[H][W];

        for (int r = 0; r < H; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < W; c++) {
                if (isWall(r, c, H, W, hWall, vWall)) {
                    boolean n = isWall(r - 1, c, H, W, hWall, vWall);
                    boolean s = isWall(r + 1, c, H, W, hWall, vWall);
                    boolean e = isWall(r, c + 1, H, W, hWall, vWall);
                    boolean w = isWall(r, c - 1, H, W, hWall, vWall);
                    maze[r][c] = boxChar(n, s, e, w);
                } else {
                    maze[r][c] = ' ';
                }
            }
        }

        maze[1][0] = ENTRANCE_EXIT;
        maze[H - 2][W - 1] = ENTRANCE_EXIT;

        return maze;
    }

    private boolean isWall(int r, int c, int H, int W, boolean[][] hWall, boolean[][] vWall) {
        if (r < 0 || r >= H || c < 0 || c >= W) return false;
        if ((r & 1) == 1 && (c & 1) == 1) return false; // cell
        if (r == 0 || r == H - 1 || c == 0 || c == W - 1) return true; // boundary
        if ((r & 1) == 0 && (c & 1) == 1) { // Type A: horizontal wall
            return hWall[r / 2 - 1][(c - 1) / 2];
        } else if ((r & 1) == 1 && (c & 1) == 0) { // Type B: vertical wall
            return vWall[(r - 1) / 2][(c - 2) / 2];
        } else { // Type C: junction
            return isWall(r - 1, c, H, W, hWall, vWall)
                || isWall(r + 1, c, H, W, hWall, vWall)
                || isWall(r, c - 1, H, W, hWall, vWall)
                || isWall(r, c + 1, H, W, hWall, vWall);
        }
    }

    private char boxChar(boolean n, boolean s, boolean e, boolean w) {
        if (n && s && e && w) return '┼';
        if (s && e && w) return '┬';
        if (n && e && w) return '┴';
        if (n && s && e) return '├';
        if (n && s && w) return '┤';
        if (s && e) return '┌';
        if (s && w) return '┐';
        if (n && e) return '└';
        if (n && w) return '┘';
        if (e && w) return '─';
        if (n && s) return '│';
        if (n || s) return '│';
        if (e || w) return '─';
        return ' ';
    }
}
